controls: 64 injected allocator failures refund exact original node byte/count admission. Separate oversize reservations deny ordinary/total bytes before allocator work; actual layout currently reaches count ceilings first.
Actual empty 64-byte authority-layout candidate nodes fill ordinary and total count ceilings. Pressure vectors are fixture-owned; they do not carry fake published capability charges.
64 ordinary and 64 trusted denial calls hold the real global heap lock. Serial and capability admission remain unchanged.
Promoting an ordinary root cannot reclassify its node backing. Trusted-root backing uses reserve at ordinary exhaustion without granting platform capability resource admission.
All six authority kinds publish, escrow, roll back and detach under the actual heap and node-pool guards; unused storage is finished after guard exit.

Existing preparation/detached-record abandonment retains exactly two ordinary authority nodes and original capability charges under lifecycle, capability, heap and new node-pool guards; no extra deliberate retained fixture.

Real detached record survives source root close and ASID reuse with original account/byte/count charge. At total exhaustion, explicit release returns exactly one ordinary node; a successor record consumes that exact capacity.
Stale exact-generation preflight rejects while heap and node pool are locked; no allocation or admission against the successor. Identity exhaustion, cancellation and rejection restore unused backing.
The existing shared retirement collection host controls establish allocation release before node-charge refund; authority resource charge stays outside and after the retired-node release callback.
qualification_limits: Actual candidate-node pressure is serialized kernel-fixture work, not sustained concurrent hostile EL0 fairness or real native heap exhaustion. Allocator failure is injected.

Independent backing admission does not grant leases, resource reserve privileges, physical completion, replay or a new recovery owner. Existing containing caller/IRQ/destructor qualification remains open.
Allocator bookkeeping, aggregate principal/general-heap admission, other payload/registry nodes and waker/callback storage remain outside this change. SEC-07 remains partial.
